accentFill.note: One small solid glyph inside a container icon (map pin, search lens), or tiny solid shapes like loader petals. Never a filled outer silhouette.

plinth.use: temples and architecture sit on a full-width rounded baseline

containerShape.name: kalasha-dome
containerShape.use: UI container with a small ogee bump on top centre (share, dots, menu). Plain rounded squares are used for neutral UI like copy.

measured.source: reference sheet of 20 icons (raster, white on black)
measured.note: Reference is an AI-rendered raster, so stroke varies 8 to 10px. Values are ranges, not exact. The library uses 2 so the set reads clearly at 16px and stays consistent across the clean batch.
